name: Ramie Carrière
source:
The self-proclaimed “Ramie, the Great Phantom Thief of the Century.” He is a thief who mainly targets the wealthy.

He excels at both picking pockets and picking locks with his dexterous fingers. 
He also makes great use of his acrobatic skills, using his cat-like agility to scale walls.

He’s friendly and always looks to brighten the mood, but he hates being touched by others.

Hometown: Annecy [France]
